g.title: artifact_type:cell_vector Promoted per-cell scalar/categorical vector such as pseudotime, labels, entropy, or module score.
artifact_type:cell_vector_family Promoted keyed family of per-cell vectors, for example UCell signatures or chromVAR deviations.
artifact_type:feature_table:cell_vector_assoc Promoted feature_table artifact with table_type='cell_vector_assoc'.
artifact_type:feature_table:de_wilcox Feature-level differential expression/accessibility statistics.
artifact_type:feature_table:feature_trend_spearman Feature-level association with a continuous vector such as pseudotime.
artifact_type:feature_table:knn_pseudobulk Feature summaries over KNN neighborhoods.
artifact_type:feature_table:markers_topn Top-ranked marker features per group.
artifact_type:feature_table:trajectory_branch_compare Feature-level branch comparison statistics.
artifact_type:feature_table:trajectory_de Feature-level differential or dynamic statistics along trajectory lineages.
artifact_type:model_ref Promoted model reference for projection or method-specific reuse.
artifact_type:obs_table:attach_report Promoted obs_table artifact with table_type='attach_report'.
artifact_type:obs_table:cell_suffix_label Promoted obs_table artifact with table_type='cell_suffix_label'.
artifact_type:obs_table:cell_vector_assoc_group_stats Promoted obs_table artifact with table_type='cell_vector_assoc_group_stats'.
artifact_type:obs_table:cell_vector_association_cells Per-cell values used in a continuous-by-continuous association.
artifact_type:obs_table:cell_vector_association_contingency Observed and expected counts for categorical-by-categorical cell-vector association.
artifact_type:obs_table:cell_vector_association_summary Typed association result with dispatched method, effect size, and validity diagnostics.
artifact_type:obs_table:cell_vector_compare Promoted obs_table artifact with table_type='cell_vector_compare'.
artifact_type:obs_table:cell_vector_compare_summary Promoted obs_table artifact with table_type='cell_vector_compare_summary'.
artifact_type:obs_table:cell_vector_family_calibration_summary Promoted obs_table artifact with table_type='cell_vector_family_calibration_summary'.
artifact_type:obs_table:cell_vector_family_graph_smooth_summary Per-key diagnostics for nearest-neighbor smoothing of a cell_vector_family over a bundle space.

g.title: artifact_type:obs_table:cell_vector_family_qc_group_summary Promoted obs_table artifact with table_type='cell_vector_family_qc_group_summary'.
artifact_type:obs_table:cell_vector_family_qc_key_summary Promoted obs_table artifact with table_type='cell_vector_family_qc_key_summary'.
artifact_type:obs_table:cell_vector_family_qc_pairwise_summary Promoted obs_table artifact with table_type='cell_vector_family_qc_pairwise_summary'.
artifact_type:obs_table:cell_vector_family_reduce_decision_table Promoted obs_table artifact with table_type='cell_vector_family_reduce_decision_table'.
artifact_type:obs_table:cell_vector_family_reduce_summary Promoted obs_table artifact with table_type='cell_vector_family_reduce_summary'.
artifact_type:obs_table:cell_vector_winners Per-cell winner, runner-up, confidence, and pruning metrics from a cell_vector_family.
artifact_type:obs_table:chromvar_summary Summary statistics for chromVAR motif deviations.
artifact_type:obs_table:derived_cell_set_manifest Lifecycle manifest for a named derived cell set, including role, status, counts, recipe availability, source summary, and derivation metadata.
artifact_type:obs_table:derived_cell_set_rules Ordered per-rule audit table for a derived cell set, including input/output counts and selector/source fields.
artifact_type:obs_table:feature_set_import_manifest One row per parsed feature set with namespace, collection, mapped-gene counts, status, and source metadata.
artifact_type:obs_table:feature_set_import_rejected Feature sets rejected during import, typically because no source genes mapped to the target matrix.
artifact_type:obs_table:feature_set_import_summary Summary counts for a feature-set library import into bundle namespaces.
artifact_type:obs_table:feature_set_overlap_qc Per-set raw, mapped, detected, duplicate, and include/exclude screening metrics against a matrix.
artifact_type:obs_table:feature_set_overlap_qc_summary Namespace-level overlap QC summary for imported feature-set libraries.
artifact_type:obs_table:feature_set_transfer_manifest One row per source feature set transferred or rejected between source and target matrices.
artifact_type:obs_table:feature_set_transfer_rejected Feature sets rejected during matrix namespace transfer because retained target members failed thresholds.
artifact_type:obs_table:feature_set_transfer_summary Summary of matrix-scoped feature-set namespace transfer between comparable matrices.
artifact_type:obs_table:generic Promoted obs_table artifact with table_type='generic'.
artifact_type:obs_table:ingest_report Promoted obs_table artifact with table_type='ingest_report'.
artifact_type:obs_table:knn_neighbors Cell-neighbor relationships from a KNN graph/query.

artifact_type:obs_table:matrix_log_normalize_summary Summary of a persisted log-normalized matrix transform, including source matrix, output matrix, scale factor, dimensions, and library-size diagnostics.
artifact_type:obs_table:pathway_enrich Pathway or gene-set enrichment summary.
artifact_type:obs_table:space_path_score_summary Promoted obs_table artifact with table_type='space_path_score_summary'.
artifact_type:obs_table:trajectory_branch_compare_summary Promoted obs_table artifact with table_type='trajectory_branch_compare_summary'.
artifact_type:obs_table:trajectory_de_summary Promoted obs_table artifact with table_type='trajectory_de_summary'.
artifact_type:obs_table:trajectory_geneset_dynamics One row per gene set with dynamics metrics and curve class.
artifact_type:obs_table:trajectory_geneset_dynamics_curve Gene-set scores over pseudotime bins.
artifact_type:obs_table:trajectory_geneset_dynamics_driver_curve Driver-gene curves for selected dynamic gene sets.
artifact_type:obs_table:trajectory_geneset_dynamics_drivers Top member genes contributing to dynamic gene-set behavior.
artifact_type:obs_table:trajectory_geneset_dynamics_summary Promoted obs_table artifact with table_type='trajectory_geneset_dynamics_summary'.
artifact_type:obs_table:trajectory_geneset_dynamics_top Promoted obs_table artifact with table_type='trajectory_geneset_dynamics_top'.
artifact_type:obs_table:trajectory_route_smooth Promoted obs_table artifact with table_type='trajectory_route_smooth'.
artifact_type:obs_table:trajectory_route_smooth_summary Promoted obs_table artifact with table_type='trajectory_route_smooth_summary'.
artifact_type:obs_table:trajectory_segment_display_path_endpoint_qc Endpoint-distance diagnostics comparing display path start/end points with declared endpoint cell-set or coordinate descriptors.

artifact_type:obs_table:trajectory_segment_join_manifest Manifest for a segmented composite trajectory, recording parent trajectory_fit_ids, artifact IDs, biological labels, join policy, and overlap counts.
artifact_type:obs_table:trajectory_segment_local_membership One row per cell per parent segment preserving local pseudotime, scaled local pseudotime, lineage weight, and waypoint role.

artifact_type:obs_table:trajectory_segment_manifest Audit manifest for one formal trajectory segment, including source kind, source engine, membership rule, normalization rule, parent artifacts, and caveats.

artifact_type:obs_table:trajectory_segment_path_join_manifest Manifest for a derived segmented composite display path, recording parent path artifacts, segment order, point ranges, trajectory_fit_ids, and display-geometry caveats.
artifact_type:obs_table:trajectory_signal_dynamics Dynamics metrics and classes for precomputed signals.
artifact_type:obs_table:trajectory_signal_dynamics_curve Precomputed signal/vector-family curves over pseudotime.
artifact_type:obs_table:trajectory_signal_dynamics_summary Promoted obs_table artifact with table_type='trajectory_signal_dynamics_summary'.
artifact_type:obs_table:trajectory_signal_dynamics_top Promoted obs_table artifact with table_type='trajectory_signal_dynamics_top'.
artifact_type:obs_table:trajectory_signature_smooth Smoothed signature/module curves along trajectory pseudotime.
artifact_type:obs_table:trajectory_signature_smooth_summary Promoted obs_table artifact with table_type='trajectory_signature_smooth_summary'.
artifact_type:obs_table:trajectory_smooth Binned/smoothed per-gene expression curves along trajectory pseudotime.
artifact_type:obs_table:trajectory_smooth_summary Promoted obs_table artifact with table_type='trajectory_smooth_summary'.
artifact_type:obs_table:trajectory_vector_smooth Promoted obs_table artifact with table_type='trajectory_vector_smooth'.
artifact_type:obs_table:trajectory_vector_smooth_summary Promoted obs_table artifact with table_type='trajectory_vector_smooth_summary'.
artifact_type:obs_table:ucell_signature_summary Summary statistics for UCell signature scores.
artifact_type:obs_table:winner_cell_set_manifest One row per registered winner-derived bundle cell set.
artifact_type:path_2d_family Promoted 2D trajectory or lineage curves.
artifact_type:relation_family Promoted sparse long-form cell-to-key relations such as branch membership.
artifact_type:space_2d Promoted reference to a 2D bundle space.
artifact_type:space_path_family Promoted high-dimensional route/trajectory paths.
getter:wb_art_dependencies Get dependency relationships for an artifact.
getter:wb_art_list List current promoted artifacts by default, optionally filtered by type or expanded to retained history.
getter:wb_art_load Load a promoted artifact as a primitive.
getter:wb_art_table_distinct List distinct values from one promoted table artifact column.
getter:wb_art_table_info Read metadata for a promoted table artifact.
getter:wb_art_table_slice Read a bounded row slice from a promoted feature_table or obs_table.
getter:wb_art_trajectory_related Find trajectory-related sibling artifacts for a source artifact.
getter:wb_bundle_overview Summarize bundle identity, validation state, registries, artifact counts, and provenance heads for read-only clients.
getter:wb_bundle_schema Inspect available SQLite schema objects in the bundle.
getter:wb_cell_coverage Summarize which cells are covered by matrices, spaces, and sets.
getter:wb_cell_metadata_columns List cell metadata columns with type, missingness, cardinality, and display hints for clients.
getter:wb_cell_sets List available cell sets in a bundle.
getter:wb_cell_vector_load Load a cell vector primitive by artifact or session reference.
getter:wb_cells Return cell IDs in canonical bundle order, optionally restricted to a cell set or dataset.
getter:wb_cells_with_matrix List cells available for a given matrix.
getter:wb_cells_with_space List cells available for a given space.
getter:wb_client_discover Client facade for discovering bundle state and available operations.
getter:wb_client_inspect Client facade for inspecting session and bundle runtime state.
getter:wb_client_load Client facade for loading primitives by reference.
getter:wb_client_load_table Client facade for loading and wrangling references into normalized tables.
getter:wb_entity_certificate Project deterministic identity and lineage metadata for any durable scientific entity.
getter:wb_entity_lifecycle List current, superseded, rejected, retracted, and ephemeral durable entity identities without reading physical storage tables.
getter:wb_entity_supersessions List explicit SUPERSEDES relationships between immutable durable identities.
getter:wb_feature_ids Get feature IDs in canonical order for a matrix.
getter:wb_feature_set_get Get feature IDs from one feature set.
getter:wb_feature_set_info Read metadata for one feature set.
getter:wb_feature_sets List feature sets and namespaces in the bundle.
getter:wb_features Read feature registry rows, optionally filtered by matrix or feature type.
getter:wb_list List common registry tables such as matrices, features, spaces, or datasets.
getter:wb_list_cell_vectors List available cell vectors from artifacts and optionally session outputs.
getter:wb_list_trajectory_models List promoted model_ref trajectory candidates with engine, provenance, and optional pseudotime coverage.
getter:wb_list_vector_sources List vector-like sources available for UI/agent selection.
getter:wb_manifest Read the atomically published authoritative manifest, or request an explicitly reconstructed diagnostic registry view.
getter:wb_matrices List matrices available in the bundle.
getter:wb_matrix Open a matrix handle for a matrix ID.
getter:wb_matrix_fragments List physical storage fragments backing a logical matrix.
getter:wb_matrix_info Read matrix registry metadata, optionally for one matrix.
getter:wb_matrix_read_feature Read one feature vector across requested cells.
getter:wb_matrix_read_features Read multiple features across cells from a logical matrix.
getter:wb_matrix_resolve Resolve matrix fragments to absolute storage paths.
getter:wb_meta Read cell-level metadata for selected cells and columns.
getter:wb_metadata_field_resolve Resolve one stable ID or unambiguous metadata name to its durable mapping.
getter:wb_metadata_fields List durable source, display, stable, and physical identities for cell metadata fields.
getter:wb_motif_libraries List registered motif libraries.
getter:wb_motif_match_get Load motif match membership rows for a match set.
getter:wb_motif_match_sets List motif match sets available for peak features.
getter:wb_motifs List motifs, optionally filtered by library.
getter:wb_nav_entities List entities that can be navigated from an artifact-backed source.
getter:wb_nav_handoff Resolve a navigation target into a client-agnostic handoff payload.
getter:wb_nav_targets List compatible navigation targets for a selected source/entity.
getter:wb_prov_artifact_lineage Return an upstream, downstream, or bidirectional composed provenance subgraph centered on one promoted artifact.
getter:wb_prov_bundle_dag Compose one canonical-ID, semantic-edge-keyed DAG across snapshots, with deterministic snapshot evidence aggregation and typed conflict rejection.
getter:wb_prov_dag Read one snapshot-local persisted provenance DAG.
getter:wb_prov_list_heads List persisted provenance snapshot heads.
getter:wb_prov_replay_equivalence_results List target-reproduction equivalence results with separate original and replayed payload SHA-256 identities.
getter:wb_prov_run_details Inspect one persisted run in an explicit snapshot, or resolve a run-only lookup uniquely across all snapshots while rejecting ambiguity.
getter:wb_prov_run_replay_inputs Rehydrate one persisted run through its registered operation contract into replay-ready typed R inputs, with historical and compatibility diagnostics.
getter:wb_read_cell_vector Read a scalar cell vector for a requested set of cells.
getter:wb_read_cell_vector_family Read one key/member from a cell_vector_family for requested cells.
getter:wb_resolve_cell_set Resolve a cell-set selector into concrete cell IDs.
getter:wb_run_history Flatten persisted provenance snapshots into a chronological run-history table.
getter:wb_search_features Search feature IDs or feature metadata.
getter:wb_session_dag Inspect an in-memory session DAG.
getter:wb_session_dag_run_details Inspect one run node from an in-memory session DAG.
getter:wb_session_view Open the session-local bundle overlay containing staged outputs before promotion.
getter:wb_slice Read a feature-by-cell matrix slice.
getter:wb_space Read coordinates for a space, optionally restricted to cells and dimensions.
getter:wb_space_info Read space registry metadata, optionally for one space.
getter:wb_space_model Get model metadata for a space.
getter:wb_space_model_path Get absolute path to a stored model file for a space.
getter:wb_spaces List spaces in the bundle.
getter:wb_spaces_with_model List space IDs that have a stored projection model.
getter:wb_status Summarize bundle health and high-level registry counts.
getter:wb_target_emit_r_script Emit a replay-and-promotion script for a target reproduction plan and writable execution clone.
getter:wb_target_reproduction_plan Resolve an artifact, matrix, space, model, or run DAG node into its minimal cross-snapshot replay closure.
getter:wb_trajectory_assert_fit_compatible Fail loudly when trajectory artifacts come from different trajectory fit families; shared labels such as L1 are not sufficient compatibility evidence.
getter:wb_trajectory_fit_info Inspect the trajectory_fit_id, engine, lineage keys, and available cell universe metadata for a trajectory primitive or promoted artifact.

getter:wb_trajectory_lineage_weights Load Slingshot lineage membership weights as a cell_vector_family from a promoted lineage_weights artifact, promoted sibling trajectory artifact, or in-memory Slingshot model_ref fallback.
getter:wb_vector Get a single feature vector across cells.
op:addmodulescore Seurat-style module scoring using matched control features by expression bin.
op:cell_set_derive Materialize a selector-derived or explicitly declared cell universe as a named cell set with lifecycle role/status and manifest tables.
op:cell_suffix_label Build a categorical cell vector by parsing cell_id suffix tokens.
op:cell_vector_assoc Test whether a continuous cell-level signal differs across groups defined by a categorical cell-level vector.
op:cell_vector_association Associate two typed cell vectors with categorical and continuous dispatch.
op:cell_vector_compare Compare two cell-level signals on their shared cell universe in raw or rank space.
op:cell_vector_family_calibrate Normalize one keyed per-cell signal family within keys so cross-key comparisons become more meaningful.
op:cell_vector_family_graph_smooth Smooth each key of a cell_vector_family over local nearest-neighbor geometry in a selected bundle space.
op:cell_vector_family_qc Compute per-key and pairwise diagnostics for one keyed per-cell signal family.
op:cell_vector_family_reduce Compress a cell_vector_family into one categorical cell_vector using explicit reduction and abstention rules.
op:cell_vector_winners Assign one winning key per cell from a cell_vector_family and report confidence and pruning metrics.
op:chromvar Bias-corrected chromVAR deviations on a peak matrix using genome-backed GC bias and motif matching against a JASPAR PWM catalog.
op:de_wilcox Wilcoxon rank-sum DE between two cell groups (A vs B).
op:feature_set_import Import GMT/RDS/table feature-set libraries into the bundle feature-set registry and emit import provenance tables.
op:feature_set_namespace_transfer Transfer matrix-scoped feature-set namespaces between comparable matrices using mirror or intersect semantics.
op:feature_set_overlap_qc Screen imported feature-set namespaces against a matrix before pathway or trajectory discovery.
op:feature_trend_spearman Feature-level Spearman trend testing against continuous pseudotime-like vectors.
op:hvg_select Select highly variable features from a matrix using chunked feature-wise summaries.
op:knn_neighbors Find nearest neighbors in a latent space without requiring matrix aggregation.
op:knn_pseudobulk Find k nearest neighbors in latent space around query cells and aggregate matrix values.
op:leiden Graph clustering on a kNN graph derived from an embedding space.
op:markers_topn One-vs-rest Wilcoxon marker ranking for each cluster.
op:matrix_log_normalize Create a reusable log1p(counts / library_size * scale_factor) BPCells matrix in the bundle.
op:metadata_cell_vector Materialize an imported cell metadata column as a typed, provenance-backed cell vector.
op:monocle3_fit Fit monocle3 graph/pseudotime using a scworkbench latent space injected into monocle3's UMAP slot.
op:monocle3_project Project a fitted monocle3 trajectory graph into a 2D display space.
op:palantir_fit Run Palantir pseudotime/branch probabilities on a scworkbench latent space via the pybench Python runtime.
op:palantir_project Project Palantir branch trajectories into a 2D display space using Palantir-style mellon interpolation from the fitted Palantir model.
op:pathway_enrich Hypergeometric enrichment against all feature sets in a namespace.
op:pca_fit Compute PCA from a matrix and selected features, then persist the cell coordinates as a bundle space.
op:peakvi_fit Train a PeakVI model on a matrix via the pybench Python runtime and emit a latent space plus model reference.
op:peakvi_project Project cells from an ATAC matrix through a saved PeakVI model and emit a latent space.
op:py_protocol_hello Qualify the PyBench v2 staging capability, receipt audit, promotion, and reopen lifecycle with lightweight typed outputs.
op:scvi_train Train an RNA scVI model on a raw/count-like matrix via the pybench Python runtime and emit a latent space, model reference, and fit summary.
op:slingshot Infer lineage curves and pseudotime from clusters in a 2D space.
op:slingshot_fit Fit Slingshot lineages/pseudotime in a chosen fit space (typically latent/PCA).
op:slingshot_lineage_weights Extract Slingshot lineage membership weights from an existing model_ref without refitting, preserving trajectory_fit_id and lineage mapping.
op:slingshot_project Project a fitted Slingshot model into a 2D display space (e.g. UMAP).
op:space_path_define Contract scaffold for checkpoint-anchored path construction in a named analytical space.
op:space_path_project_2d Contract scaffold for projecting an analytical path into a drawable 2D path family.
op:space_path_score Contract scaffold for path-relative scoring in a named analytical space.
op:trajectory_branch_compare Compare two trajectory branches feature-by-feature using explicit pseudotime and branch membership primitives.
op:trajectory_de Lineage-aware feature trend testing against trajectory pseudotime from model_ref.
op:trajectory_geneset_dynamics Screen all feature sets in a namespace for dynamic behavior along trajectory pseudotime.
op:trajectory_route_smooth Summarize per-feature expression along an explicit route using global pseudotime plus route membership weights.
op:trajectory_segment_from_artifacts Materialize the generic trajectory segment contract from fitted-model trajectory artifacts with fit-family validation.
op:trajectory_segment_join Join ordered generic trajectory segments into an auditable composite pseudotime without merging parent trajectory models.
op:trajectory_segment_path_join Join ordered parent path_2d_family segments into a derived composite display curve without merging parent trajectory models.
op:trajectory_signal_dynamics Rank precomputed cell-level signal families by dynamic behavior along trajectory pseudotime.
op:trajectory_signature_smooth Summarize feature-set signature scores along trajectory pseudotime into reusable trend tables.
op:trajectory_smooth Summarize per-feature expression along trajectory pseudotime into reusable trend tables.
op:trajectory_space_path_segment Convert space_path_score output into a generic trajectory segment using path-progress pseudotime and transparent distance-based membership.
op:trajectory_vector_smooth Summarize cell-level signal families along trajectory pseudotime into reusable trend tables.
op:ucell Rank-based per-cell signature scoring using the UCell method.
op:umap_fit Fit a UMAP model on a space and store it for future projection.
op:umap_transform Project cells into an existing UMAP using a stored model.
op:winner_cell_sets Register bundle cell sets from a cell_vector_winners obs_table and return a manifest table.
parameter:bootstrap_n Number of bootstrap resamples per bin for confidence intervals; zero disables bootstrap intervals.
parameter:cell_set Restricts the cells considered by an op. This is a biological and computational universe choice, not a cosmetic filter.
parameter:ci_level Nominal confidence level for bootstrap confidence bands.
parameter:class_min_amplitude Minimum curve range required before assigning a non-flat dynamic class.
parameter:end_label Human-readable label for the intended biological endpoint of a trajectory or dynamics analysis.
parameter:feature_sets Optional restriction to named feature sets within a namespace.
parameter:gene_id_type Records the identifier convention used by imported feature-set genes.
parameter:join_policy Rule used to convert segment-local pseudotimes into one composite pseudotime.
parameter:lineage Restricts analysis to one or more lineage/path keys from a trajectory, relation, or path family.
parameter:loess_span Controls the locality of LOESS smoothing when smooth_method is loess.
parameter:low_abundance_max_score Maximum score threshold below which dynamic-looking curves are flagged as low abundance.
parameter:mad_multiplier Threshold multiplier for median absolute deviation distance filters around a trajectory/path.
parameter:matrix Symbolic matrix primitive consumed by an op. The matrix defines the feature universe and measurement scale.
parameter:membership Optional cell_vector artifact, cell set, or cell IDs intersected with finite pseudotime cells before dynamics are computed.
parameter:min_amplitude Minimum observed/smoothed curve range required for a signal or feature set to pass report filters.
parameter:min_bins_observed Minimum number of retained pseudotime bins required for a curve to pass filters.
parameter:min_cells_per_bin Minimum number of cells required for a pseudotime bin to be retained.
parameter:min_detected_fraction Minimum fraction of feature-set members detected in the matrix before a set passes filters.
parameter:min_features_detected Minimum number of feature-set members detected in the matrix before a set passes filters.
parameter:min_max_score Minimum maximum smoothed curve score required before a gene set or signal passes report filters.
parameter:min_mean_score Minimum mean smoothed curve score required before a gene set or signal passes report filters.
parameter:min_retained_features Minimum number of source feature-set members that must remain valid on a target matrix during transfer.
parameter:min_retained_fraction Minimum fraction of source feature-set members that must remain valid on a target matrix during transfer.
parameter:min_signal_to_noise Minimum amplitude divided by mean bootstrap standard error required before a curve passes filters.
parameter:model Reference to a fitted model or trajectory object used by downstream projection/smoothing/dynamics ops.
parameter:monotonic_min_abs_rho Minimum absolute Spearman correlation with pseudotime required for monotonic on/off classes.
parameter:n_bins Number of bins used to aggregate cells along pseudotime before curve summaries and dynamics metrics.
parameter:n_permutations Number of score-pseudotime permutations used to estimate empirical dynamic-score p-values.
parameter:namespace Selects the registered collection of feature sets to screen or score.
parameter:on_off_min_delta Minimum late-minus-early absolute difference required for turns_on or turns_off classes.
parameter:output_matrix_id Matrix id assigned to a newly created bundle matrix.
parameter:overwrite Controls whether an op may replace an existing persisted bundle object with the same identifier.
parameter:p_adjust_method Multiple-testing correction method used to convert empirical p_dynamic values into q_dynamic values.
parameter:permutation_seed Seed used for empirical score-pseudotime permutation tests.
parameter:pseudotime Continuous per-cell progress coordinate, usually inferred by a trajectory method or path-scoring op.
parameter:pseudotime_direction Controls whether pseudotime is used as provided or inverted before binning, curve metrics, and class assignment.
parameter:pseudotime_key Selects the key/lineage from an explicit cell_vector_family pseudotime input.
parameter:role Declared purpose of a cell set, such as analysis_universe, exclusion_set, endpoint_set, annotation, diagnostic, or temporary.
parameter:scale_factor Target per-cell total used when converting raw counts to scaled expression before log transformation.
parameter:score_method Defines how member features are collapsed into a per-cell or per-bin feature-set score.
parameter:seed Seed used for stochastic algorithms or resampling.
parameter:signal_keys Optional restriction to selected keys in a cell_vector_family, such as UCell signatures or chromVAR motifs.
parameter:smooth_method Optional smoother applied to binned curves before metrics and class assignment.
parameter:source_engine Declares the engine or source family that produced a segment, such as slingshot, monocle3, palantir, space_path, manual, imported, graph, or unknown.
parameter:source_format Parser choice for a feature-set import source.

parameter:source_kind Declares how a trajectory segment was generated. Implemented source kinds are fitted_model and space_path_bridge; graph_path_bridge, imported_pseudotime, manual_pseudotime, and composite are reserved until adapters exist.
parameter:source_matrix_id Matrix id that owns the source matrix-scoped feature-set namespace or other transferable registry state.
parameter:source_path File-backed source for feature-set imports, such as GMT, RDS list/data.frame, or CSV-style table.
parameter:space Symbolic space primitive used for geometry, clustering, nearest-neighbor, projection, or trajectory operations.
parameter:split_by_collection Controls whether broad gene-set libraries are split into collection/subcollection namespaces during import.
parameter:start_label Human-readable label for the intended biological start of a trajectory or dynamics analysis.
parameter:status Declared maturity of a cell set, such as candidate, accepted, superseded, rejected, active, or temporary.
parameter:summary_fun Statistic used to summarize cell-level values within each bin.
parameter:target_cell_set Stable bundle name assigned to a newly materialized derived cell universe.
parameter:target_matrix_id Matrix id that will receive transferred feature-set memberships after mirror or intersect validation.
parameter:target_namespace Optional namespace assigned to transferred feature sets on the target matrix.
parameter:top_n Number of top-ranked records retained for compact outputs or reports.
parameter:trajectory_composite_id Stable identity for a derived trajectory assembled from separately fitted parent trajectory segments.
parameter:trajectory_fit_id Stable identity binding trajectory-derived artifacts emitted from one fit, including model_ref, pseudotime, lineage weights, and projected paths.
plot:category_count_bar Show counts and percentages for categorical cell-vector labels.
plot:dotplot Show feature expression summaries across groups with percent-expressed and average-expression encodings.
plot:embedding_overlay Display cells in a 2D embedding with optional color, shape, size, alpha, or set overlays.
plot:feature_rank_bar Show ranked feature values as bars.
plot:heatmap_ranked Show matrix-like feature-by-group values from ranked feature tables.
plot:pathway_bar Show ranked pathway or feature-set enrichment terms.
plot:pseudotime_signature_line Show feature-set or signal curves along trajectory pseudotime.
plot:pseudotime_smooth_panel Show per-feature smoothed expression curves along trajectory pseudotime.
plot:ranked_lollipop Show ranked entities from feature tables or obs_table summaries.
plot:trend_scatter Plot feature-level trend or association statistics as a scatter plot.
plot:violin Show distributions of per-cell vector values across groups.
plot:volcano Plot feature-level effect size against adjusted p-value for differential or trend-like feature tables.
recipe:cluster_markers_pathways Cluster cells in a chosen space, find top markers per cluster, and optionally enrich each cluster marker list.
recipe:de_to_pathway_report Run DE between two sets, convert ranked/significant features to enrichment queries, and plot top pathway terms.

recipe:feature_set_import_qc_then_dynamics Import a GMT/RDS/table feature-set library into a namespace, record import provenance, QC matrix overlap, then use the namespace in trajectory_geneset_dynamics.
g.text: Import and QC a feature-set library befor...

g.title: wrangler:plot_mapper:cell_vector_category_count_bar_v1 Counts categorical cell-vector labels for category bar plots.
wrangler:plot_mapper:cell_vector_violin_v1 Combines a numeric cell vector with a grouping vector to form distribution data.
wrangler:plot_mapper:feature_table_dotplot_v1 Maps marker-style feature group summaries to dotplot columns.
wrangler:plot_mapper:feature_table_feature_rank_bar_v1 Maps feature tables with score-like values to ranked bar data.
wrangler:plot_mapper:feature_table_heatmap_ranked_v1 Maps feature-by-group values to a matrix-like ranked heatmap dataset.
wrangler:plot_mapper:feature_table_pathway_bar_v1 Maps pathway enrichment observation tables to ranked pathway bars.
wrangler:plot_mapper:feature_table_ranked_lollipop_v1 Maps feature or observation tables with score-like columns to ranked entity data.
wrangler:plot_mapper:feature_table_trend_scatter_v1 Maps feature trend statistics to a feature_scatter plot dataset.
wrangler:plot_mapper:feature_table_volcano_v1 Maps differential or trend-like feature tables to volcano plot columns.
wrangler:plot_mapper:space2d_overlay_v1 Combines a 2D space with optional cell-vector overlays into an embedding_overlay dataset.
wrangler:plot_mapper:trajectory_pseudotime_signature_line_v1 Maps signature, gene-set, signal, or driver curves to pseudotime line datasets.
wrangler:plot_mapper:trajectory_pseudotime_smooth_panel_v1 Maps trajectory_smooth tables to per-gene pseudotime curve panels.
